name: Model Prompts
description: Append or prepend system-prompt text for specific models or providers.

rules.label: Prompt Rules
rules.help: Each rule adds text to the system prompt for the models it matches. Also turn on conversation access for this plugin under Permissions, or the rules do nothing.

rules.*.match.label: Model
rules.*.match.help: Which model gets this text: a provider/model pattern where * matches anything. Use opencode-go/* for a whole provider, or */deepseek-* for a model on any provider.

rules.*.text.label: Prompt text
rules.*.text.help: Added to the system prompt, wrapped in OpenClaw's plugin-context block.
rules.*.text.placeholder: Before each tool call, write one short sentence saying what you are about to do.

rules.*.position.label: Where to add it
rules.*.position.help: append (default) puts the text near the end of the prompt. prepend puts it at the very top.

rules.*.agents.label: Only these agents
rules.*.agents.help: Agent ids (wildcards allowed). Leave empty to apply to every agent.

rules.*.enabled.label: Enabled
rules.*.enabled.help: Turn off to keep the rule without applying it.

rules.*.id.label: Name
rules.*.id.help: Optional label shown in log warnings.
